narrative.overview:
WildTrail blends editorial wildlife publishing with tactile reserve cartography. Rather than trapping parks inside repetitive boxed grids, the system follows the natural progression of a single day inside an Indian tiger reserve: golden-hour morning mist over laterite forest tracks (#FAF6EC and #EFE3CA), shaded Sal-forest corridors and river crossings (#DCE7DF and #2B6964), and fire-lit twilight base camps (#071713 warmed by #E58C3A).

Every interface surface balances crisp typographic warmth with disciplined field telemetry. Serif display headings honor heritage field journals, sans-serif body text keeps permit rules effortlessly scannable, and monospace tabular coordinates turn reserve elevations and sighting probabilities into credible expedition data.
keyCharacteristics: Continuous atmospheric progression from Dawn Mist to Emerald Canopy to Fire-Lit Night Camp.
Tactile cartographic hierarchy pairing vector contours and laterite road geometry with restrained glassmorphic journals.
Strictly calibrated day (#F8F7F2) and Night Safari (#071713) polarity without sacrificing contrast (>= 4.5:1).

rules.name: The Brass Restraint Rule
rules.body: Field Brass Gold (#C99A4A) marks decisive expedition CTAs, active GPS beacons, and numeric telemetry—never large multi-column card fills.

rules.name: The Atmospheric Polarity Rule
rules.body: Field Journal cards adopt warm parchment (#FAF6EC) during Dawn Mist and Midday Canopy stops, then transition cleanly to dark slate (#0C211B) under Night Camp firelight to preserve contrast.

rules.name: The Zero-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Headings open directly with Playfair Display titles; supporting GPS coordinates and meter elevations live in dedicated card metadata bars or alongside actions rather than stacked kickers above titles.

rules.name: The Single-Elevation Rule
rules.body: Interactive Field Journal cards and HUD controls use crisp 1px borders (#D8C9AA or #265244) paired with subtle backdrop blur—avoiding heavy competing drop-shadows on layered terrain.

dos: Do keep Field Journal coordinates, elevation, and INR prices formatted with tabular-nums and whitespace-nowrap.
Do preserve prefers-reduced-motion bypasses so Lenis inertia, suspension jitter, dust plumes, and foliage parallax disable cleanly when requested.
Do keep trailside bank markers (Ramganga Timber Bridge) offset from the roadbed so timber planks and Jeep splashes remain unobstructed.
donts: Don't place numbered kickers, uppercase category eyebrows, or floating badges above Playfair Display headings.
Don't overlap bottom-left Compass HUD controls and bottom-right Ask Ranger triggers on narrow 390px mobile screens.
Don't write ResizeObserver-measured heights back onto an observed parent container.
